launcher.help:
sing-box.WebAPI - the headless Web API service of sing-box

Usage: sing-box.WebAPI [options]

Options:
  --foreground        Run in the foreground; Ctrl+C stops it safely and logs stay on the terminal
  --background        Run in the background, detached from the terminal (Linux default in a terminal)
  --no-open           Do not open the browser on startup
  --stop              Stop the instance running for the same data directory (Linux only)
  --help, -h          Show this help and exit

Other arguments (for example --urls http://0.0.0.0:5080) are passed to the web host.

Common configuration (environment variables; can live in an .env file next to the executable):
  SING_BOX_WEB_API_KEY          Management Key; required when listening beyond 127.0.0.1
  ASPNETCORE_URLS             Listen address, default http://127.0.0.1:5080
  SING_BOX_WEB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS  Allowed cross-origin sources
  SING_BOX_WEB_AUTOSTART=true   Start the Core together with the web service
  SING_BOX_WEB_PROXY_PORT       Local proxy port (used by update checks)

Docs: https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/tree/master/v2rayN/v2rayN.WebAPI
